```yaml
name: Bump Progressive Rollout Version Command
on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  bump-version:
    if: github.event.issue.pull_request != null && contains(github.event.comment.body, '/bump-progressive-rollout-version')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install airbyte-ci
        run: |
          pip install airbyte-ci

      - name: Get PR number
        id: pr
        run: echo "pr_number=${{ github.event.issue.number }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Get modified connectors
        id: get_modified_connectors
        run: |
          modified_connectors=$(gh pr view ${{ github.event.issue.number }} --json files --jq '.files[].path' | grep -E '^airbyte-connectors/.*connector\.yaml$' | sed 's|airbyte-connectors/\(.*\)/connector\.yaml|\1|' | head -n 10)
          echo "modified_connectors=$modified_connectors" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Bump version with RC suffix
        run: |
          for connector in ${{ steps.get_modified_connectors.outputs.modified_connectors }}; do
            if [ -n "$connector" ]; then
              echo "Bumping version for connector: $connector"
              airbyte-ci connectors --modified bump-version --rc --connector-name "$connector"
            fi
          done
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}

      - name: Comment success message
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}
          script: |
            const { pr_number } = require('./.github/actions/bump-version-command.json');
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: `✅ Successfully bumped versions with RC suffix for progressive rollout.\n\nNext steps:\n1. Review the updated connector versions in your PR\n2. Ensure the \`enableProgressiveRollout: true\` flag is set in metadata.yaml\n3. Merge the PR when ready for staging`
            })
```
